name: Sea ice
notes: Frozen sea surface: no plants; near-empty is correct. Only ice-algae (diatoms) colour the underside of the floes, and polar ice-edge rock carries crustose lichen and moss where floes ground against shore (Arctic and Antarctic).

ground.name: Ice algae
ground.source: underwater — Nitzschia frigida, dominant Arctic sea-ice diatom, brown algal film on the underside of floes, mm-cm scale — Wikipedia / polar research literature

ground.name: Map lichen
ground.source: Rhizocarpon geographicum, Arctic and Antarctic ice-edge rock and nunataks, yellow-green crustose lichen, mm-thick — Wikipedia

ground.name: Antarctic moss
ground.source: Bryum pseudotriquetrum, bipolar moss of polar coastal rock and meltwater seeps beside sea ice, cushions 1-5 cm — Wikipedia / British Antarctic Survey
